headline.title: If you’re giving a commencement speech in 2026, maybe don’t mention AI
headline.summary: A recent article discusses the challenges of inspiring graduating students about their future in a world increasingly influenced by artificial intelligence. It suggests that speakers may want to avoid mentioning AI in commencement speeches to maintain a positive outlook.

articles.title: Why trust is a big question at the Elon Musk-OpenAI trial
articles.summary: The trial involving Elon Musk and OpenAI has raised significant questions about the trustworthiness of OpenAI CEO Sam Altman. As the proceedings conclude, the focus remains on the implications of trust in the context of AI development and leadership.

articles.title: Revamped Siri will reportedly offer auto-deleting chats
articles.summary: Apple's upcoming Siri update in iOS 27 will reportedly feature an auto-deleting chat history option, emphasizing the company's commitment to user privacy. This move aims to enhance Siri's functionality as it evolves to be more chatbot-like, amid increasing competition in the AI space.

articles.title: University of Arizona students boo Eric Schmidt’s AI cheerleading during commencement
articles.summary: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt faced boos from University of Arizona students during his commencement address as he discussed artificial intelligence. The negative reaction reflects the students' concerns about AI's impact on the job market they are about to enter.

articles.title: TechCrunch Mobility: The AI skills arms race is coming for automotive
articles.summary: The automotive industry is entering an AI skills arms race as companies compete to develop advanced technologies for vehicles. This shift highlights the growing importance of AI expertise in shaping the future of transportation.

articles.title: Chatbots at the drive-thru are just the beginning
articles.summary: McDonald's has begun implementing AI-driven chatbots at drive-thrus, marking a significant step in the integration of artificial intelligence into everyday customer service. This initiative is part of a broader trend of AI adoption across various sectors, indicating a shift in how businesses interact with consumers.

articles.title: Sony tries to explain that its AI Camera Assistant doesn’t suck
articles.summary: Sony is clarifying the functionality of its AI Camera Assistant on the Xperia 1 XIII, following criticism from a demonstration post. The company emphasizes that the feature provides suggestions based on lighting, depth, and subject, rather than editing photos directly.

articles.title: OpenAI co-founder Greg Brockman takes charge of product strategy
articles.summary: OpenAI co-founder Greg Brockman has taken over the company's product strategy amid plans to integrate ChatGPT with its programming tool, Codex. This restructuring reflects OpenAI's ongoing efforts to enhance its product offerings.

articles.title: The haves and have nots of the AI gold rush
articles.summary: The article discusses the growing divide in the tech industry amid the ongoing AI boom, highlighting concerns about inequality and access to resources. It emphasizes that despite the rapid advancements in AI, the overall sentiment within the industry is not positive.

articles.title: Research repository ArXiv will ban authors for a year if they let AI do all the work
articles.summary: ArXiv has announced a new policy that will impose a one-year ban on authors who submit papers that rely entirely on AI-generated content. This move aims to address concerns over the careless use of large language models in scientific research.

articles.title: Some Asexuals Are Using AI Companions for Intimacy Without the Sex
articles.summary: Some asexual individuals are turning to AI companions for emotional intimacy and role-playing, as reported by WIRED. However, this trend has sparked concern among some asexual advocates who feel it misrepresents their community.
